Distill its 24 pre-transform actor targets into the same state-conditioned Policy while preserving the complete no-reset Mission progression, Program prior, lateral-only authority, bilateral consistency regularizer, seed, budget, and locked Judge.
proposal.expectedEffect: Teach the actor a physically screened early brace without splitting locomotion, impact, and recovery into separate deployed policies. The short proxy remains Training-only; promotion still requires the unchanged walk→impact→recover→resume→redirect→traverse→stop Mission Suite to improve without regressions.
